Aisha: Quick PSA  I swapped my desk lamp for tiny fairy lights to test a holiday vibe. If your monitor looks weird its just me being festive :sparkles:
Tom: Love it. Pro tip: try the warm-white setting so the screen color doesn't go funky. Also please photo or it didnt happen :camera:
Riley: Photo incoming. Also whos up for a "Secret Mug Swap" next week? Leave a note on your mug if youre in. Small, silly gift exchange.
Hana: Im game. Rules: leave a mug cleaned, with a sticky note that says one fun fact about you. Pick a mug, guess the owner, then reveal Friday at lunch.
Aisha: Fun fact: my fun fact will be "I once sang backup for a mariachi band". That should throw people off.
lights-bot: Reminder scheduled: Fri 12:00 in #random  "Secret Mug Swap reveal + fairy light awards" :white_check_mark:
Tom: Also tiny contest: most ridiculous desk light wins a $10 coffee card. Post photos here.
Riley: Uploading mug photo now. Mine has a chip but it's perfect for instant ramen and bad puns.
Hana: Signed up. If anyone wants help hanging extra lights in the kitchen common area, I can bring cable ties and an extra ladder Saturday morning.
Aisha: Thanks team. Holiday micro traditions are my favorite low-effort culture wins. See you at the reveal! :mug_with_heart:
